reworked_diffusion_policy.checkpoint
====================================

.. py:module:: reworked_diffusion_policy.checkpoint

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Simple checkpoint management utilities for training and evaluation.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   reworked_diffusion_policy.checkpoint.CheckpointManager


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: CheckpointManager(directory: str | pathlib.Path, prefix: str = 'diffusion_policy', *, run_id: Optional[str] = None, top_k: int = 0, maximize_metric: bool = False)

   Handles persistence of training checkpoints with optional Top-K tracking.


   .. py:attribute:: directory


   .. py:attribute:: prefix
      :value: 'diffusion_policy'



   .. py:attribute:: run_id
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: top_k


   .. py:attribute:: maximize_metric
      :value: False



   .. py:attribute:: _topk_entries
      :type:  List[Dict[str, object]]
      :value: []



   .. py:method:: latest_path() -> pathlib.Path

      Return the path used for the most recent checkpoint.

      :returns: Absolute path to the ``latest`` checkpoint file.



   .. py:property:: _base_prefix
      :type: str


      Base filename prefix that optionally includes the run id.


   .. py:method:: set_run_id(run_id: str) -> None

      Update the run identifier used in filenames.

      :param run_id: Unique identifier appended to checkpoint filenames.



   .. py:method:: save(*, model: torch.nn.Module, optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer, epoch: int, global_step: int, ema_model: Optional[torch.nn.Module] = None, metric: Optional[float] = None, update_latest: bool = True) -> pathlib.Path

      Persist the latest checkpoint to disk.

      :param model: Model whose parameters should be saved.
      :param optimizer: Optimiser state to persist alongside the model.
      :param epoch: Current epoch index.
      :param global_step: Global optimisation step.
      :param ema_model: Optional EMA copy to include.
      :param metric: Validation metric used for Top-K tracking.
      :param update_latest: Skip the ``latest`` symlink/file update when ``False``.

      :returns: Path to the checkpoint file written (``<prefix>_latest.pt``).



   .. py:method:: load(path: str | pathlib.Path, map_location: Optional[str | torch.device] = None) -> dict

      Load a checkpoint payload from disk.

      :param path: Checkpoint file to read.
      :param map_location: Optional device remapping for tensors.

      :returns: Deserialized checkpoint payload.



   .. py:method:: _update_topk(*, metric: float, payload: Dict[str, object], epoch: int, global_step: int) -> None

      Persist checkpoints for the best ``top_k`` metrics seen so far.

      :param metric: Metric value produced by the latest evaluation.
      :param payload: Checkpoint payload dictionary.
      :param epoch: Epoch index associated with the payload.
      :param global_step: Global optimisation step for filename generation.



   .. py:method:: clear() -> None

      Remove cached Top-K entries from disk.
